scope: all Infinite Domain algorithmically generated structures
required_sequence: define building archetype, capacity, zones, adjacencies and circulation
build and preserve an intact clean master
perform a heavy architectural articulation pass appropriate to the archetype
validate entrances, doors, windows, floors, vertical circulation and room purpose
render exterior A, exterior B, roof-off cutaway and floor slices
perform manual rendered review and correct defects
derive localized damage, environment and occupation variants from the clean master
repeat validation and rendered review for every derivative
walk the structure in the QA world
admit to production world generation only after explicit approval
heavy_rebuild_minimum: massing appropriate to use rather than an undifferentiated cuboid
facade depth, structural bays and room-specific windows
credible roof, drainage, foundation and utility treatment
complete internal room program with usable circulation
site elements that explain road access, servicing and exterior use
damage that follows a localized physical story and preserves original-use legibility
